svg.title: Ohvara logo, unflapped vs flapped — traced from hand sketches
svg.desc: Left: unflapped, wide open pose — white sail swept left, teal spike tall and pointed, overlapping at center. Right: flapped — teal's own top spike folds down onto itself (new jagged crease at top), white tucks almost entirely behind teal, only a small wedge still visible at the right edge. Whole mark reads shorter and more compact.
